Concerns have also emerged regarding unusual trades in a central government security with a long maturity.

items.author: TOI WORLD DESK
items.description: A complex legal battle unfolded over a lakeside property in Virginia involving a widow and the children of her deceased husband. This ruling reversed a prior decision and provided clarity on property rights, paving the way for future partition proceedings while maintaining the widow's current living situation.

He challenged this dismissal, claiming that the hearing was improperly conducted. The Pennsylvania Supreme Court ruled in his favor, underscoring that no elected board members were present during his hearing.

items.title: Euclid telescope finds 31 ancient quasars, two shining like a trillion suns
items.author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
items.description: The Euclid space telescope has made a groundbreaking discovery by identifying 31 ancient quasars, significantly contributing to the field of astronomy. Notably, two of these quasars hold the record for their vast distances, originating when the Universe was just 670 million years old. Their light journeyed over 13 billion years to reach Earth, offering unparalleled insights into the early stages of cosmic history.

items.description: Palerang Homestead, a stunning property in New South Wales, is up for sale after nearly three decades under family stewardship. This estate is not only historically rich, with ties to Mick Jagger during the filming of Ned Kelly, but also exemplifies sustainable farming practices that have garnered international praise. With its working farm and agricultural opportunities, this estate promises to attract diverse potential buyers, merging history with farming viability.

items.title: No tax on capital gains from sale of MFs by Mauritius funds: HC
items.description: The Delhi High Court ruled that capital gains on equity-oriented mutual fund units are not taxable in India. The decision clarified the interpretation of the India-Mauritius tax treaty regarding taxation of capital gains. Gains from mutual fund units can only be taxed in Mauritius and not in India. The ruling arose from a tax dispute involving Emerging India Focus Funds, a Mauritius tax resident.
